text:
SALINAN
LEMBARAN DAERAH KABUPATEN CIREBON
NOMOR 1 TAHUN 2018 SERI E.1
PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN CIREBON
NOMOR 1 TAHUN 2018
TENTANG
PERLINDUNGAN, PEMBERDAYAAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA
translated_text:
COPY
REGIONAL GAZETTE OF CIREBON REGENCY
NUMBER 1 YEAR 2018 SERIES E.1
REGIONAL REGULATION OF CIREBON REGENCY
NUMBER 1 YEAR 2018
CONCERNING
PROTECTION AND EMPOWERMENT OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN BY THE GRACE OF THE ONE ALMIGHTY GOD
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "PERLINDUNGAN, PEMBERDAYAAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK" should be rendered as "Protection and Empowerment of Women and Children" (missing conjunction and "anak" is pluralized as "children").

text:
DEWAN PERWAKILAN RAKYAT DAERAH
KABUPATEN CIREBON
BUPATI CIREBON
MEMUTUSKAN:
Menetapkan : PERATURAN DAERAH TENTANG PERLINDUNGAN,  PEMBERDAYAAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK.
translated_text:
REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES
CIREBON REGENCY
REGENT OF CIREBON
DECIDES:
To Establish : REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE PROTECTION, EMPOWERMENT OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN.

qa_issues: Meaning drift in item 6: 'keyakinan politik' translated as 'political beliefs' instead of 'political convictions/beliefs' (acceptable) but more importantly 'pengurangan penyimpangan' rendered as 'reduction, distortion'—'penyimpangan' here is 'deviation' and the phrase should be 'reduction, deviation, or elimination' (not 'distortion').

Meaning drift/grammar affecting meaning in item 17: 'dan Tidak Langgsung' (and indirect [efforts]) mistranslated as 'and indirect' without stating 'indirect efforts' and missing the sense that prevention includes both direct and indirect efforts.

text:
BAB III
KABUPATEN LAYAK ANAK
Pasal 4
(1) Dalam rangka implementasi Konvensi Hak Anak dan berbagai peraturan  perundang-undangan dan kebijakan terkait pemenuhan hak anak dan  perlindungan khusus anak, Pemerintah Daerah, swasta dan lembaga  masyarakat melakukan upaya mewujudkan Kabupaten Layak Anak.
(2) Untuk mewujudkan Kabupaten Layak Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), Pemerintah Daerah, swasta dan Lembaga Masyarakat  memperhatikan hak anak yang berkaitan dengan hak hidup, tumbuh  kembang perlindungan dan partisipasi.
(3) Pemerintah Daerah, Swasta dan Lembaga Masyarakat dalam mewujudkan  Kabupaten Layak Anak tergabung dalam Gugus Tugas Kabupaten Layak  Anak.
(4) Gugus Tugas Kabupaten Layak Anak bertanggungjawab pada pemenuhan hak  anak yang berkaitan dengan :
a. Hak sipil dan kebebasan;
b. Lingkungan keluarga dan pengasuhan alternatif;
c. Kesehatan dasar dan kesejahteraan;
d. Pendidikan, pemanfaatan waktu luang dan kegiatan seni budaya; e. Perlindungan khusus anak.

qa_issues: Meaning drift in item (a): "penggunaan sepenuhnya" was translated as "full enjoyment"; more accurate is "full use"/"full utilization" in this context.

text:
Pasal 9
(1) Kewajiban dan tanggung jawab Swasta dan masyarakat sebagaimana  dimaksud dalam Pasal 7 huruf b, diselenggarakan dalam bentuk peran serta  masyarakat dan bersama.
(2) Bentuk peran serta swasta dan masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1), meliputi:
a. Mencegah terjadi tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak; b. Memberikan informasi dan/atau melaporkan tindak kekerasan terhadap  perempuan dan anak kepada penegak hukum atau pihak yang  berwenang; dan
c. Turut serta dalam penanganan korban tindak kekerasan.
(3) Bentuk peran serta masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2),  dilaksanakan secara bertanggungjawab sesuai ketentuan peraturan  perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 9
(1) The obligations and responsibilities of the Private sector and community as referred to in Article 7 letter b, shall be implemented in the form of community participation and collectively.
(2) The form of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (1), includes:
 a. Preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children;
 b. Providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; and
 c. Participating in the handling of victims of acts of violence.
(3) The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2), shall be implemented responsibly in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 10
Kewajiban keluarga dan/atau orangtua sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 7  huruf c dan huruf d, yang secara hukum memiliki tanggung jawab penuh  untuk mencegah segala bentuk kekerasan dan melindungi perempuan dan anak  sebagai anggota keluarga.
translated_text:
Article 10
The obligations of the family and/or parents as referred to in Article 7 letter c and letter d, who by law have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and to protect women and children as members of the family.

qa_issues: Meaning drift in item (g): Indonesian states 'pos perlindungan perempuan dan anak' (protection post for women and children), but the translation reads 'protection posts for women and children' and omits the word 'pos' as an alternative designation; adjust to reflect 'or by another designation as a protection post for women and children from acts of violence'.
Meaning drift: "Pemulangan" translated as "Repatriation"; should be "Return" (repatriation implies return to one's country).

text:
Pasal 14
(1) Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban menyediakan pelayanan pengaduan  perlindungan, pemberdayaan perempuan dan anak.
(2) Pemerintah Daerah dan masyarakat atau lembaga pelayanan sosial dapat  membentuk rumah pemulihan atau rumah aman.
translated_text:
Article 14
(1) The Regional Government is obligated to provide complaint services for the protection and empowerment of women and children.
(2) The Regional Government and the community or social service institutions may establish recovery houses or safe houses.

text:
Pasal 15
Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai pelayanan pengaduan dan pelayanan sosial  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 14 diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 15
Further provisions regarding complaint services and social services as referred to in Article 14 shall be regulated by a Regent Regulation.

text:
BAB VIII
KELEMBAGAAN
Pasal 16
(1) Dalam rangka pelayanan perlindungan kepada perempuan dan anak dari  tindak kekerasan, Pemerintah Daerah membentuk Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu  Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak (P2TP2A) atau dengan sebutan lainnya sebagai pusat pelayanan terpadu dalam perlindungan perempuan dan anak  dari tindak kekerasan termasuk korban tindak kekerasan.
(2) Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak (P2TP2A) atau dengan sebutan lain sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), berfungsi  sebagai leading sektor pusat pelayanan terpadu dalam memberikan  perlindungan kepada perempuan dan anak dari tindak kekerasan.
(3) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai organisasi dan tata kerja Pusat Pelayanan  Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak (P2TP2A) atau dengan  sebutan lain sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), ditetapkan dengan  Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII
INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK
Article 16
(1) In the context of providing protection services to women and children from acts of violence, the Regional Government establishes an Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children (P2TP2A) or another designation as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence, including victims of acts of violence.
(2) The Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children (P2TP2A) or another designation as referred to in paragraph (1), functions as the lead sector of the integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
(3) Further provisions regarding the organization and working procedures of the Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children (P2TP2A) or another designation as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be stipulated by a Regent's Regulation.

text:
Pasal 18
(1) Gugus tugas dan komite aksi daerah sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 17 merupakan lembaga koordinatif yang bertugas mengkoordinasikan  pencegahan dan penanganan perdagangan orang.
(2) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai pembentukan, tugas, dan fungsi gugus  tugas sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), ditetapkan dengan  Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 18
(1) The task force and regional action committee as referred to in Article 17 constitute a coordinative institution tasked with coordinating the prevention and handling of human trafficking.
(2) Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task force as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be stipulated by a Regent Regulation.

text:
BAB IX
KERJA SAMA DAN KEMITRAAN
Bagian Kesatu
Kerja sama
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX
COOPERATION AND PARTNERSHIP
Part One
Cooperation

text:
Bagian Kedua
Kemitraan
translated_text:
Second Part
Partnership

text:
Pasal 20
(1) Pemerintah Daerah membentuk kemitraan dengan dunia usaha dalam  perlindungan perempuan dan anak dari tindak kekerasan.
(2) Kemitraan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan melalui: a. Pemberitahuan informasi kesempatan kerja bagi perempuan korban tindak  kekerasan;
b. Pendidikan dan pelatihan bagi perempuan korban tindak kekerasan;
c. Bantuan pendidikan bagi perempuan dan anak korban tindak kekerasan  yang tercabut dari pendidikannya; dan
d. Menumbuhkan dan meningkatkan kemandirian ekonomi perempuan  korban tindak kekerasan.
(3) Kemitraan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2), dituangkan  dalam bentuk perjanjian.
translated_text:
Article 20
(1) The Regional Government establishes partnerships with the business sector in the protection of women and children from acts of violence.
(2) Partnerships as referred to in paragraph (1) are conducted through: a. Notification of employment opportunity information for women victims of acts of violence;
b. Education and training for women victims of acts of violence;
c. Educational assistance for women and children victims of acts of violence who have been withdrawn from their education; and
d. Fostering and increasing economic independence of women victims of acts of violence.
(3) Partnerships as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2), are set forth in the form of an agreement.

CHAPTER X
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 21
(1) Regional Government is obligated to conduct guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection, empowerment of women and children.
(2) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1), includes:
a. Guidelines and fulfillment standards;
b. Technical guidance and training;
c. Provision of facilities;
d. Monitoring; and
e. Evaluation.
(3) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2), is in order to realize the objectives of protection, empowerment of women and children in accordance with minimum service standards implemented by SKPD and the community.
(4) Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), is conducted with the principles of being professional, transparent, and accountable.

text:
Pasal 22
Masyarakat dapat melakukan pengawasan penyelenggaraan perlindungan  pemberdayaan, perempuan dan anak yang diselenggarakan oleh Pemerintah  Daerah dengan mekanisme penyampaian aspirasi kepada Bupati atau kepada  DPRD.
translated_text:
Article 22
The community may conduct supervision of the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women and children carried out by the Regional Government through a mechanism for conveying aspirations to the Regent or to the DPRD.

text:
BAB XI
PEMBIAYAAN
Pasal 23
Pembiayaan penyelenggaraan perlindungan, Pemberdayaan perempuan dan  anak bersumber dari:
a. Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN);
b. Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah (APBD); dan
c. Sumber lain yang sah sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang undangan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XI
FINANCING
Article 23
Financing for the implementation of protection, Empowerment of women and children is sourced from:
a. State Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBN);
b. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBD); and
c. Other lawful sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 24
(1) Pemerintah Daerah dapat memberikan bantuan pembiayaan kepada  organisasi masyarakat, organisasi sosial atau lembaga swadaya  masyarakat yang melaksanakan perlindungan, pemberdayaan perempuan dan  anak dari diskriminasi dan tindak kekerasan.
(2) Bantuan pembiayaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), sesuai dengan  kemampuan keuangan daerah, dan dilaksanakan sesuai ketentuan  peraturan perundang-undangan di bidang keuangan daerah.
translated_text:
Article 24
(1) The Regional Government may provide financing assistance to community organizations, social organizations, or non-governmental organizations that carry out the protection and empowerment of women and children from discrimination and acts of violence.
(2) Financing assistance as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be provided in accordance with regional financial capacity and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

text:
BAB XII
KETENTUAN PENUTUP
Pasal 25
Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal diundangkan.
Agar setiap orang mengetahuinya memerintahkan pengundangan Peraturan  Daerah ini dengan penempatannya dalam Lembaran Daerah Kabupaten Cirebon.
Ditetapkan di Sumber  pada tanggal 26 Januari 2018 BUPATI CIREBON, Ttd
translated_text:
CHAPTER XII
CLOSING PROVISIONS
Article 25
This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.
In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Cirebon Regency.
Enacted in Sumber on 26 January 2018 REGENT OF CIREBON, Signed
